# A top level run_as_cel: true, with an optional comment, is detected.
celfmt -agent -i true.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_true.txt

celfmt -agent -i comment.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_comment.txt

# Anything else is not detected, so cel.program is left unchanged.
celfmt -agent -i title.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout title.cel

celfmt -agent -i upper.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout upper.cel

celfmt -agent -i key.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout key.cel

celfmt -agent -i quoted.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout quoted.cel

celfmt -agent -i templated.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout templated.cel

celfmt -agent -i nested.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout nested.cel

celfmt -agent -i commented.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout commented.cel

-- true.cel --
run_as_cel: true
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- want_true.txt --
run_as_cel: true
cel.program: |-
  1 + 1
-- comment.cel --
run_as_cel: true # Run as CEL.
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- want_comment.txt --
run_as_cel: true # Run as CEL.
cel.program: |-
  1 + 1
-- title.cel --
run_as_cel: True
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- upper.cel --
run_as_cel: TRUE
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- key.cel --
RUN_AS_CEL: true
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- quoted.cel --
run_as_cel: "true"
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- templated.cel --
run_as_cel: {{run_as_cel}}
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- nested.cel --
other:
  run_as_cel: true
cel.program: |
  1+1
-- commented.cel --
# run_as_cel: true
cel.program: |
  1+1
